component.name: MS 365 MCP Server
component.summary: MCP server for Microsoft 365 mail, calendar and to-do tasks

description.p: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes Microsoft 365 through the Microsoft Graph API, letting AI assistants and other MCP-compatible tools work with Outlook mail, calendar and Microsoft To Do tasks. Optional presets also cover OneDrive files, contacts, Excel and Teams.

ul.li: Mail: read, search, send and manage Outlook messages
Calendar: list, create and update events
Microsoft To Do: manage task lists and tasks
MSAL authentication (device-code or app credential flow)
Tool filtering via presets or Graph scope allowlists
Support for both STDIO and HTTP transports

description.p: Initial Debian packaging, forked from Softeria/ms-365-mcp-server.
